data.one_liner: Create animated splash screens with customizable assets, transitions, and navigation.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedSplashScreen widget that displays a splash screen using asset images, URLs, icons, or custom widgets with various splash and page transitions before navigating to the next screen.
use_when: You need an animated introductory splash screen before loading the main app screen.
You want to animate asset images, network images, icons, or custom widgets during app startup.
avoid_when: You need a native OS-level splash screen that appears instantly during app cold start before Flutter initializes.
You do not require any animations for your splash screen.
strengths: Supports multiple input types for the splash (assets, URLs, IconData, or custom Widgets).
Offers various built-in splash animations and page transition types.
weaknesses: Does not replace native platform splash screens which handle the initial delay before Flutter boots up.
Limited to predefined transition options unless using customTweens.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedSplashScreen(
  splash: 'images/splash.png',
  nextScreen: MainScreen(),
  splashTransition: SplashTransition.rotationTransition,
  pageTransitionType: PageTransitionType.scale,
)
